study: R158 replacement of text-to-winner decoding, preceding any new task scores
cohort: all 1798 EXT records in the R145 registry, in original order, six directed tasks; already exposed
model: three existing fully source-prepared frozen checkpoints. New decoder of decisions, no source training, no test-time weight update, no external experts
candidate_universe: 256 original A boxes with fixed physical seed IDs and all six original decoder position tensors. Re-encode target and directly linked reference phrases on those anchors, never match role-forward query numbers from fresh proposals.
language: full-sentence native scores from literal target head, equal log weight with separately encoded subject phrase and explicit appearance field; missing parse falls back to full-sentence native evidence
B: registered B on A coordinates, coverage per A box from visible registered seeds; mix centered candidate log evidence with B weight <=0.5. No B goes through the same new A reader. A-camera layout only.
inference: normalize semantic posterior across all candidates with inverse sum of squared overlaps as duplicate density; marginalize known left/right target-reference edges across all reference hypotheses, neutral for unavailable geometry, explicit target image-position intervals with half-neutral lapse. Decode expected pairwise 3D box IoU. All arms share final sampled-A PCA, additionally report axis-aligned scores.
report: design-weighted six-direction mean and by direction and B availability; mIoU, Acc25/50, all paired improvements and losses, box overlap and unknowns. Report stratified scene results. Compare modified base scores and identical geometry. No per-case, domain or endpoint selection.
decision: prefer primary for continued development only if above joint_zero on mIoU and stronger than old_scores_risk; component evidence requires its own matched ablation. Do not deploy solely based on this exposed cohort. Keep baseline if primary fails.
